segments.name: Banking
segments.description: A community-focused bank offering loans, deposits, wealth management and trust services to individuals, businesses, municipalities and nonprofits in Texas.
segments.evidence: We are a community-focused financial institution that offers a full range of financial services to individuals, businesses, municipal entities and nonprofit organizations in the communities that we serve.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest and fees on loans to consumers, businesses and municipalities, and fees from deposit, wealth management, trust and brokerage services.
revenueModel.evidence: These services include consumer and commercial loans, deposit accounts, wealth management, trust and brokerage services.
